highlights.title: Track the contact region
highlights.label: 01 / Motion & collision
highlights.text: A SphereCast sweeps the detection point’s travelled segment during an animation-driven attack window. A collider is processed once per swing.
highlights.detail: Contact area and sweep radius are separate controls, so pressure tuning does not change collision thickness.

highlights.title: Evaluate before presenting
highlights.label: 02 / Impact solver
highlights.text: Alignment, hardness and pressure classify each hit. The strength input is mass × velocity: a momentum-inspired control value for the authored response.
highlights.detail: “Penetrated” is a result label; the system does not cut or fracture the mesh.

highlights.title: Localize and release the deformation
highlights.label: 03 / Shader Graph
highlights.text: Material hardness and elasticity scale the displacement. Spatial falloff localizes it, while hold time, damped oscillation and reduced rebound control its recovery.
highlights.detail: A MaterialPropertyBlock supplies per-object parameters. The frozen implementation uses contact area directly as the visual radius.

highlights.title: Share the evaluated impact
highlights.label: 04 / Data & presentation
highlights.text: ScriptableObjects hold weapon and material presets. A common ImpactData event feeds VFX and Debug observers; deformation is called directly on the receiver.
highlights.detail: Each material selects its particle prefab. Effects face the surface normal, with a small downward spawn offset.

materials: A local depression recovers as blue droplets leave the surface.
Separate mesh particles burst away; the target remains intact.
A short spark burst marks contact with the hard-surface target.
iterations: Splitting the two controls corrected early contact on broad weapons without changing the pressure model.
Geometry is part of the shader
Slime’s topology and normals were revised to address faceting and uneven highlights during development.
Carapace became Metal so the target and spark effect expressed the same material idea.
